needs.proposedSignature: StaticEffect { kind: 'grant-alt-cost'; scope: 'you-control' | 'all'; zone: 'graveyard' | 'hand' | 'exile'; filter: Filter; who?: 'you' | 'opponent' | 'any'; alt: { id: AltCostId; label?: string; cost: AbilityCost | 'card-mana-cost'; plus?: AbilityCost; from: CastZone } } — 'card-mana-cost' is the new cost form for 'the escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus …'.
needs.semantics: A static that gives OTHER cards an alternative cost they do not print: 'Each enchantment card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard.' (The Master of Keys), 'Dinosaur spells you cast have prowl {2}{R}.' (Hunting Velociraptor). `altCosts` is a per-card declaration on `CardDef`; legal.ts reads it from the card being cast only, so nothing can inject one into a set of cards in another zone. This family name already carries 3 cards in data/scripts/needs.json.
needs.clause: Each enchantment card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard.

needs.proposedSignature: AltCostId 'prowl' — altCosts: [{ id: 'prowl', label: 'prowl {5}{U}', cost: { mana }, from: 'hand', condition: { kind: 'prowl-enabled', filter: { subtypes: ['Rogue'] } } }] — with a new Condition { kind: 'prowl-enabled'; filter?: Filter } that reads a per-turn record of which creatures dealt combat damage to a player (default: a creature sharing a type with the spell), and Condition { kind: 'prowled' } for the 'if this spell's prowl cost was paid' rider, alongside the existing `kicked` / `evoked` / `escaped`.
needs.semantics: CR 702.76a: 'Prowl [cost]' means 'You may pay [cost] rather than pay this spell's mana cost if a player was dealt combat damage this turn by a source that, at the time it dealt that damage, was a creature that shares a creature type with this spell.' Neither the alternative-cost id nor the combat-damage-history condition exists; `escaped` shows the shape a `prowled` condition would take.
needs.clause: Prowl {5}{U} / Dinosaur spells you cast have prowl {2}{R}.
